file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive 4-phase investigation workflow for new-project bootstrap path validation
key_content: Phase 1: Reproduce scenarios across web (Next.js) and mobile (iOS, Android) stacks
Phase 2: Root cause analysis for both web and mobile services
Phase 3: Implementation fixes for MASTER_PROMPTs and pipeline
Phase 4: Validation across all supported stacks
file_insights.structure: JSON with phases containing subtasks, each with status, expected outputs, and verification criteria
file_insights.completion_status: Partially complete - Phase 1 and 2 mostly done, Phase 3-4 pending

file_insights.purpose: Document identified root causes for mobile MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap failures
findings: 6 critical gaps identified (5 shared with web, 1 mobile-specific)
iOS Variant A and Android Variant B both generated 800-1000+ lines of excellent content
Critical issue: No files were actually created despite excellent output generation
Mobile-specific gap: Variant selection logic (iOS/Android/KMP routing not implemented)
file_insights.evidence_basis: Reproduction testing on minimal iOS and Android projects

patterns_discovered.pattern: Content Generation vs. File Creation Disconnect
patterns_discovered.description: MASTER_PROMPTs successfully generate comprehensive architecture documentation (800+ lines) but fail to create actual files
MASTER_PROMPTs lack explicit 'new-project' trigger detection and conditional logic
Pipeline handles ARCHITECTURE.md differently than PROJECT_MAP.md, causing inconsistent behavior in new projects
Mobile stack requires routing logic for iOS/Android/KMP variants, but this logic is missing from MASTER_PROMPT
No clear documentation on how/when to invoke MASTER_PROMPT for new projects vs. existing projects

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Successful prompt output does not guarantee file creation
gotchas_discovered.context: iOS and Android MASTER_PROMPT variants generated comprehensive 800-1000+ line architecture documents but created zero files
gotchas_discovered.implication: Need explicit file-writing instructions in prompts, not just content generation

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Mobile requires multi-variant routing that web doesn't
gotchas_discovered.context: iOS (Variant A), Android (Variant B), and KMP need different bootstrap paths, but prompt lacks variant detection
gotchas_discovered.implication: Cannot use web-based solution as-is for mobile; need variant-aware logic

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Pipeline Phase 1 assumes ARCHITECTURE.md already exists
gotchas_discovered.context: Pipeline context-load phase expects ARCHITECTURE.md to exist, but new projects don't have it yet
gotchas_discovered.implication: Pipeline needs graceful degradation for new projects, possibly a fallback to MASTER_PROMPT invocation

gotchas_discovered.context: Prompts reference creating files but lack specific, actionable file-write instructions
gotchas_discovered.implication: Need explicit 'write these exact files' sections with clear output formats

phases_completed: Phase 1: Created minimal test projects for web and mobile stacks
Phase 2: Analyzed failures and identified root causes
key_achievements: Identified 6 critical gaps in mobile MASTER_PROMPT (5 shared + 1 mobile-specific)
Documented evidence from iOS and Android reproductions

next_steps: Phase 3: Implement fixes in MASTER_PROMPTs and pipeline
Phase 4: Validate fixes across all stacks (web, iOS, Android, KMP)

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit 'File Creation' sections to MASTER_PROMPTs that specify exact files to write with complete file paths and content
recommendations.rationale: Current prompts generate content but don't create files; need actionable file-write instructions

recommendations.recommendation: Implement variant detection logic in mobile MASTER_PROMPT to route iOS (Variant A), Android (Variant B), and KMP differently
recommendations.rationale: Mobile has fundamentally different architecture needs per platform; variants must be supported from bootstrap

recommendations.recommendation: Add graceful degradation in pipeline.md Phase 1 to detect new projects (missing ARCHITECTURE.md) and guide toward MASTER_PROMPT usage
recommendations.rationale: Pipeline currently assumes ARCHITECTURE.md exists; needs to handle new-project case explicitly

recommendations.recommendation: Add invocation documentation showing when/how to use MASTER_PROMPT vs. FEATURE_PROMPT for new vs. existing projects
recommendations.rationale: Current documentation doesn't clarify new-project bootstrap flow

recommendations.recommendation: Use Phase 4 validation to test all stacks (Next.js, React, Vue for web; iOS, Android, KMP for mobile) with fixes applied
recommendations.rationale: Comprehensive validation will catch edge cases across platform variants

recommendations.recommendation: Keep minimal test projects in version control for ongoing bootstrap path validation
recommendations.rationale: Enables regression testing and continuous validation of new-project flows
